features.title: Account Switcher
features.description: Remember encrypted ChatGPT logins and switch accounts from the profile menu without restarting the desktop app.

features.title: Agent Workspaces
features.description: Adds an opt-in Linux settings page and Electron bridge for agent-workspace-linux hidden desktop environments.

features.title: API Key Model Visibility
features.description: Opt-in desktop model picker support for non-hidden models reported by API-key authenticated OpenAI-compatible providers.

features.title: API Key Service Tier
features.description: Opt-in Fast/service-tier UI and request support for API-key authenticated OpenAI-compatible providers.

features.title: Linux AppShots
features.description: Opt-in AppShots composer integration that captures and crops a selected Linux window without core AppShots backend changes.

features.title: Authenticated HTTP Proxy
features.description: Opt-in launcher and main-process support for HTTP proxies that require username/password authentication.

features.title: Keep Authored Messages Visible
features.description: Keep assistant and user messages visible when completed tool activity collapses.

features.title: Automation Extensions
features.description: Optional multi-time scheduling and eager automation_update tool exposure.

features.title: Browser Runtime Proxy
features.description: Passes explicit standard proxy environment variables from the Codex app-server to Browser Use node_repl helpers.

features.title: ChatGPT reply Markdown fallback
features.description: Show the saved Markdown reply when the interactive reply renderer fails to start or render.

features.title: ChatGPT Dots in Any Country
features.description: Keep the ChatGPT Dots entry route visible when the account response is country-gated.

features.title: Separate ChatGPT Sidebar History
features.description: Default the ChatGPT sidebar to Chat and remember the selected Chat/Work/All history filter.

features.title: Chronicle / Skysight Activity Memory
features.description: Opt-in Linux activity memory with Chronicle controls and a standalone Skysight MCP server.

features.title: Codex Micro hardware support
features.description: Enables the upstream Work Louder Codex Micro service on Linux and adds narrow USB-C/Bluetooth hotplug and hidraw policy while reusing the official node-hid binding.

features.title: Community Features in GUI Settings
features.description: Show a read-only community feature dependency tree with build status in Settings > General.

features.title: Community Profile Isolation
features.description: Pins ChatGPT Community to its own Codex state, Electron profile, CLI, and child-command environment for every launch path, including absolute updater relaunches.

features.title: Linux Computer Use
features.description: Optional Linux desktop-control UI and native MCP backend integration.

features.title: Copilot Reasoning Effort Defaults
features.description: Opt-in patch that lets Copilot-auth sessions persist and select reasoning effort defaults on Linux.

features.title: Directory-Only Working-Tree Watch
features.description: Uses Watchbound for bounded Linux working-tree watching while retaining Codex Git-ignore and logical-path policy.

features.title: Filesystem Root Follow-ups
features.description: Allow follow-up messages in existing local tasks whose working directory is /.

features.title: Flatpak Chrome Native Messaging
features.description: Bridges the official Chrome extension host into the Flatpak Google Chrome sandbox without adding sandbox overrides.

features.title: Frameless Titlebar
features.description: Hide Linux titlebar overlay controls and native menu chrome for compositor-managed window decorations.

features.title: Global Dictation
features.description: Opt-in global dictation hotkeys for Linux using X11 and XDG desktop portal backends.

features.title: GNOME Global Dictation Companion
features.description: Opt-in, helper-authenticated GNOME Shell Ctrl+V companion for Global Dictation; requires manual extension activation.

features.title: Linux Performance Workarounds
features.description: Optional measured renderer workarounds for affected Linux systems.

features.title: MCP Helper Reaper
features.description: Reaps orphaned MCP helpers after their Codex owner exits without touching live sessions.

features.title: Model Picker Default Presets
features.description: Opt-in ChatGPT Default model-picker presets configured as ordered model and effort pairs.

features.title: Browser Use node_repl Reaper
features.description: Reaps Browser Use node_repl helper processes leaked by the upstream codex app-server: on launch, periodically while the app runs, and on exit.

features.title: Omarchy Theme
features.description: Loads user CSS generated from the active Omarchy theme into ChatGPT Community.

features.title: Persistent Status Panel
features.description: Keep the Codex /status panel open across thread switches and app restarts until explicitly closed.

features.title: Pet Overlay
features.description: Optional Linux avatar overlay placement and compositor hints.

features.title: Open source links in the preferred editor
features.description: Open source and text file references in the selected editor with a plain click.

features.title: Project Group Last Updated Sorting
features.description: Makes Last updated reorder project groups as well as their tasks in the Projects sidebar.

features.title: Project Task Created Sorting
features.description: Restores Created sorting for populated local tasks in the alternate Projects sidebar.

features.title: Read aloud
features.description: Opt-in Linux read-aloud button for assistant responses.

features.title: Read Aloud MCP
features.description: Disabled-by-default MCP plugin that lets the agent read text aloud through the Linux Read Aloud voice backend.

features.title: Reasoning Visibility Setting
features.description: Add an opt-in General setting to show available reasoning summaries and keep them expanded after completion.

features.title: Record & Replay
features.description: Opt-in Linux demo-to-skill recording workflow powered by codex-record-replay-linux.

features.title: Remote Control UI
features.description: Adds opt-in Linux visibility patches for remote control and related settings surfaces.

features.title: Experimental Remote Mobile Control
features.description: Opt-in Linux adaptation for experimental Remote host and outbound-control flows.

features.title: Shallow Linux Repository Watches
features.description: Prevents transient repository previews from recursively walking working trees and Git metadata on Electron's main thread.

features.title: Shared App-Server Socket
features.description: Opt-in protocol-transparent Unix socket shared by ChatGPT Community and one or more ordinary app-server clients.

features.title: Start Minimized to Tray
features.description: Add opt-in General settings to start hidden in the existing Linux system tray, with a login-autostart-only option.

features.title: Thorium Chrome Plugin Support
features.description: Adds disabled-by-default Thorium support to the bundled Chrome plugin on Linux.

features.title: Tray Usage
features.description: Show the current Codex usage remaining in the Linux system-tray menu.

features.title: UI Tweaks
features.description: Optional UI customization patches for ChatGPT Community.

subfeatures.title: Dock icon
subfeatures.description: Expose the Dock icon selector and synchronize the selected icon with Linux windows, tray and supported launchers.

subfeatures.title: Extended UI font size
subfeatures.description: Raise the UI font-size maximum to a configurable value.

subfeatures.title: Custom font input
subfeatures.description: Switch between installed fonts and a manually entered CSS font-family stack.

subfeatures.title: Suggested prompts
subfeatures.description: Expose Suggested Prompts in settings and enable project-aware cards on Home.

subfeatures.title: Expanded model picker
subfeatures.description: Open the advanced picker by default and show models inline with their supported reasoning efforts.

subfeatures.title: English reasoning effort labels
subfeatures.description: Keep reasoning effort names in English in the Simplified Chinese interface.

subfeatures.title: Selection: More details
subfeatures.description: Restore the selected-text More details action that asks Quick Chat to explain the selection.

subfeatures.title: Annotation submit shortcut
subfeatures.description: Send the active selected-text annotation with Ctrl+Enter without the regular composer intercepting it.

subfeatures.title: Sidebar project names
subfeatures.description: Apply a configurable style to project names in the sidebar.

features.title: Wayland Global Shortcuts
features.description: Use native Wayland portals for built-in popout, Mini/Pet, Appshots, voice and meeting shortcuts.
